title: Ultrahuman store footer
description: A white store footer: four link columns split by pale vertical rules, each holding two groups with small uppercase grey titles and 16px black links (with an optional tiny 'New' badge); a three-cell row for contact, social icons and black app badges; small grey legal lines with two rounded pills; and the company name set huge in pale black italic across the full width. On phones the groups become an accordion.
notes: the phone accordion is native details elements: no JavaScript
the giant wordmark is SVG text stretched to the full width (textLength), so any name fills it
name: ultrahuman-footer

props.name: columns
props.description: four columns, each a stack of link groups split by a hairline (desktop); one accordion list on phones

props.name: contact
props.description: the contact cell: a title and lines such as an email and a phone number

props.description: the app cell: black store badges
